text: 🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Raphinha's call up to Brazil? Deco and I have also spoken about Raphinha. After what happened during the last international break, there’s not much we can do. He’s our captain here, but he also wants to represent his country whenever he’s called up.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Raphinha: “Every player wants to represent their national team and help their country. I’d be happy if he could manage his minutes a little. We know travelling isn’t ideal in this situation, but it’s beyond my control.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We have to accept the defeat and learn from it. It’s not easy to cope with the absence of four defenders, but we’re working on finding solutions.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on the Ballon d’Or: “Harry Kane also deserved to win it, and Lamine is certainly at that level too. I liked what Lamine said about Cubarsí; he deserved the Kopa Trophy after an incredible season.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Signing a CB? We’re open to signing anyone who can help improve the team, but we’ll see what happens. There are still a few weeks to go before the winter transfer window opens.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “If we can sign someone in winter, we might do it.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Fariñas: “Brian Fariñas is an option to play at RIGHT-BACK. He’s very intelligent and does it fantastically well. He deserves to play; THIS is HIS moment.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Rodri is right, sometimes we need to play with a bit more calmness.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “I’m 100% convinced by my football philosophy and playing style. We will continue playing this way until the END.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Frenkie de Jong: “I can only speak from my personal perspective, because I’m completely CONVINCED of Frenkie’s abilities. When he’s fully fit, he’s already an exceptional player. For me, Frenkie is a fantastic and very important player for our team. His presence raises the team’s overall level and improves the quality of our performances.” #fcblive ⭐

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Alejandro Balde? I think he may currently be lacking the confidence he needs to perform at his best. He also needs to have more belief in our style of play, because we always look to attack and press high, and the full-backs play a very important role in these situations. Balde needs to regain his confidence so he can get back to performing at his best.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Barcelona’s defence: “Defending is not just the defenders’ responsibility; everyone has a role to play. First, we must avoid losing possession cheaply, as we did against Madrid. That wasn’t good enough and not the level of quality we usually show. As I said, perhaps we weren’t at our freshest. We need to play with greater focus, and when defending inside the box, it’s important to mark our opponents properly. We didn’t do that well enough, and it’s something we must improve. We’re working on it in training and discussing it with the players. We have to manage these situations better.” #fcblive
Frenkie de Jong 🏃‍♂️
